d: 🗂 We’re Hiring: Esports Operations Manager | Gaming Tournament Coordinator

We are seeking an organized and passionate Esports Operations Manager | Gaming Tournament Coordinator to oversee esports activities, manage gaming competitions, and coordinate tournament operations. This role combines esports event management, tournament planning, team coordination, sponsor engagement, and operational development. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of the gaming industry, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to manage competitive gaming events from planning through execution.
Plan, organize, and oversee esports tournaments, gaming competitions, and related events.
Coordinate tournament schedules, match formats, registration processes, and competition rules.
Manage relationships with esports teams, players, coaches, referees, and event partners.
Coordinate event venues, gaming equipment, technical requirements, and production arrangements.
Ensure tournaments operate smoothly and comply with competition rules and event guidelines.
Monitor match schedules, player participation, results, and tournament progress.
Work with technical teams to ensure stable gaming platforms, streaming systems, and event infrastructure.
Coordinate sponsorship activities, brand partnerships, and promotional campaigns.
Support marketing and community engagement initiatives to increase tournament participation and audience reach.
Manage event budgets, operational resources, and supplier arrangements.
Resolve scheduling conflicts, technical issues, and operational challenges during competitions.
Prepare tournament reports, performance reviews, and recommendations for future esports events.
Background in Esports Management, Sports Management, Event Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of esports tournaments, competitive gaming environments, and gaming communities.
Knowledge of tournament structures, match scheduling, competition rules, and player coordination.
Experience in event planning, gaming operations, or tournament administration is an advantage.
Familiarity with esports titles, streaming platforms, tournament management software, and gaming technologies.
Understanding of sponsorship coordination, event marketing, and community engagement.
Strong organizational, communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple event activities and work under time-sensitive conditions.
Willingness to coordinate with players, teams, sponsors, vendors, and technical personnel.
Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Event Management, Sports Management, Business, or a related field is preferred. Relevant esports or event management certifications are an advantage.
Opportunities to manage esports tournaments and gaming industry events.
Exposure to professional gaming competitions and international esports communities.
Collaboration with gaming teams, event organizers, sponsors, and industry partners.
Opportunities for professional development and industry networking.
Career progression into Senior Esports Operations Manager, Esports Event Director, or Head of Gaming Operations roles.
A dynamic and gaming-focused working environment.
Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.
Legally authorized to reside and work in the UAE.
Tourist and visit visa holders are not eligible.
Must have a personal UAE bank account to receive salary payments.
Previous professional experience is an advantage but not mandatory.
